blockers: Standups 13, 22 and 24 are placed from the RetroRitchie table. Playfield tilt 29 still lacks direct geometry. Standup-wall and below-playfield effect projections remain observed.

The original matrix uses overlays and cap lights and omits 56. The RetroRitchie build maps all fitted playfield lamps, including 56, to hidden lightmap sources. The IPDB underside and Pinside views cross-check layout, but a measured socket survey is still needed.

The factory Snake Pit has two flash sockets. Neither table identifies both physical sockets. The VLM build supplies 23 modelled playfield G.I. fixtures, but the factory complement and positions remain open. System 6 exports no G.I. channel.
coordinate_convention: x 0 left to 1 right and y 0 rear to 1 apron; VPX bounds normalized to six decimal places.

gi_modelled_bulbs.authority: Modelled fixtures in the VLM table only. The factory schematic establishes unswitched G.I. routing. The modeled count does not establish the total factory quantity.
gi_modelled_bulbs.method: Split world-space connected pieces with 0.1-VPU weld. Use each 18.10–18.60 VPU square envelope within 4 VPU of a GI light once.
